transactions.title: Untitled (Infinity Study No. 1) — Hand-Knotted Fiber Sculpture, Original One-of-a-Kind Wearable Art Object
transactions.description:
Behold: a single continuous gesture, frozen mid-thought.

This piece began as an ordinary elastic band — until it didn't. Through a deliberate act of self-intersection, the artist coaxed the material into a lemniscate, the ancient symbol of infinity, rendered here not in stone or bronze but in humble stretch-jersey cord, because true genius needs no marble.

Note the tension in the crossing point — that single knot is the entire emotional climax of the work, a moment of irreversible commitment after which the piece can never return to its original, unknotted innocence. Some have called this "just a hair tie." Those people have never truly looked.

Photographed here under warm ambient light on reclaimed oak, evoking themes of domesticity, containment, and the quiet violence of elastic recoil. Each viewing angle reveals a new interpretation: a Möbius strip. A cursive lowercase "e." The number 8, lying down, exhausted from existing.

This is not merely an accessory. It is a meditation on duality — the two loops representing the eternal tension between order and chaos, between "put your hair up" and "give up entirely."

One of one. Will never be repeated, mostly because the artist does not remember exactly how they tied it.
